tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsang ba'i rnam thar bka' rgya ma bzhugs so// oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ dpal rta mgrin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gi yon tan brjod par mi 'os na'ang / /rang dang 'dra ba'i dad ldan slob ma yi/ /rang dang bstan pa snying la bcags nas bskul/ /rang gzhan kun la phan pas 'dir brjod nyon/ /kho bo blo gsal rgya mtsho yi/ /gsang ba'i rnam thar bsdus pa 'di/ /bstan 'dzin slob brgyud yon bdag dang / /las can rnams la phan pas smros/ /snyigs dus skye bos sdig gsog pas/ /snod min rnams la gsang bar gyis/ /kho bos rang gi bsti gnas la sogs pa'i gnas chen rnams su/ lam zab la sogs pa'i bya spyod bla med kyi rim pa rnams nyams su blangs pas nyams rtogs kyi myu gu skyes pa rnams gzhan du bstan zin/ kho bos rje btsun chen po'i sgrub gnas 'dir/ dpal rta mgrin gyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum la 'bad pas zhal mngon sum du mthong zhing gsung gi gnang ba yang ci rigs pa thob pas rkyen byas/ rje btsun chen po dang dpal rta mgrin la gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ mos gus kyi klong rol nas nyams dang rtogs pa 'ur nas cha lung gi rgyab kyi brag ri rnams thogs med du nyul nas sla ri'i thad kyi nam mkha'i mthongs su/ rje btsun chen po dang dngos su mjal bas/ cung zad cig had de lus 'dug pa la/ rje btsun chen po'i zhal nas/ bu nga dang 'phrad pa ngo mtshar che/ bu nga'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten longs la nga'i bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du bka' babs kyi gnas gsum du zhog la/ gnyer gtad bka' bsgo dam par gyis gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur pas/ cung zad nas nyams sangs nas dga' bde'i ngang la yug cig lus 'dug de nas mdun gyi brag skyibs shig nas/ sil snyan ma ṇi ma zhig dang gnam lcags kyi rdo rje zhig 'dug pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten du go nas/ nam mkha'i mthongs nas zhal gzigs pa'i sku la 'dra 'bag blangs nas rab gnas mang du byas nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni/

dpal ldan sa skya'i gdung rabs dang bstan 'dzin skyes chen rnams kyi don du sku rten dang / zangs sbug gi tshogs dung rag bcus ma/ rje btsun nyid kyi sku tshe'i 'du byed bstan pa'i gnas su bzhugs su gsol/ tshogs bdag la bka' bsgos/ klu sgrub rgya mtsho la gnyer du gtad/ gsung gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba chos rgyal 'dar pa 'khor 'bangs kyi don du/ gsung gi rten sil snyan ma ṇi ma dang bdud rtsi ril bu ka pā li gang / sla ri'i shug sdong la sbas/ sman btsun la bka' bsgos/ sgrub chen ma la gnyer du gtad/ rjes 'jug slob ma'i don du gnam lcags rdo rje dang bkras dar mthing khra bzhi/ rang gi bsti gnas su spyan drangs nas/ nag po chen po la bka' bsgos/ mkhyen brtse ba la gnyer du gtad/ slar yang rje btsun chen po'i zhal yang yang mthong ba dang / brag ri rnams dpa' bo mkha' 'gror mthong ba mang du byung ngo / /'khon gyi gdung rabs dar 'dod na/ /sku rten nyid la mchod pa gyis/ /tshogs kyi bdag po'i sgom bzlas dang / /dam tshigs nyams chags sku la bshags/ /chos rgyal chab srid dar 'dod na/ /sla ri gces 'dzin bya ra mdzod/ /sman mo mchod cing bka' bsgo bya/ /gsung gi dam tshig yang yang bskul/ /rjes 'jug bstan 'dzin dar 'dod na/ /thugs kyi rdo rje bskul ba dang / /nag po chen por mchod gtor dang / /las bcol bskul dang dam bzhag mdzod/ /sku rten ma 'gyur gdung mi 'chad/ /'khon brgyud srog shing yin nam snyam/ /sla ri sman mo'i phyag gnas na/ /chos rgyal chab srid gnas sam snyam/ /thugs rten nag po'i sku nyid la/ /rjes 'jug bstan pa gnas sam snyam/ /snyigs dus skye bos sdig gsog pas/ /mang por ma spel gsang ba zhu/ /cha lung sgrub chen ma'i bskul ma'i ngor/ blo gsal ming can gyis dpe gsum bris nas/ bka' babs kyi gnas gsum du bzhag sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya// //bkra shis// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT
